protocol.bars: nvda_1m causally aggregated to 30m; out-of-session buckets used only for the overnight and gap anchors
protocol.clock: New York wall-clock encoded as fake UTC; nothing converts
protocol.entry_spread_note: measured Dukascopy median spread for nvda; the requested 0.2 USD reads as 11.774bp on this symbol and 0.2 pips as 0.1177bp; see the cost sweep in `validate`
protocol.fx: every symbol is USD-quoted, so the FX leg is a constant 1.0
protocol.in_sample: 2020-07-01 through 2024-12-31; 2020 H1 is warm-up and 2021-2024 are the gated years
protocol.selection_gate: >=3 of 4 in-sample years profitable; selected DD 3.0-15.0%; annual DD <=15.0%; >=200 trades; PF >=1.05; regime filters must refine an already profitable unfiltered cell; >=60% of numeric neighbours robust; >=80.0% of signals fillable on $1,000 in sample
protocol.session: 09:30-15:30 New York in 30m buckets; entries inside it only, forced flatten in the 15:30 bucket (the tables end 15:59, so there is no 16:00 bar)
protocol.sizing: riskvol_1.5pct against a per-symbol volatility target of 0.440 (in-sample median realised volatility), floored to the 0.01 share step inside 0.0500 margin (Exness stocks 1:20); the step and the margin leg are both inert at these balances, the risk budget binds
protocol.split_adjustment: prices are ratio back-adjusted; risk sizing, notional sizing and the margin ceiling are all invariant to it, the lot step is not but is inert here
